name: cap-kyma-service
description: CAP microservice simples para Kyma/SAP BTP

scripts.docker:build-push: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.k8s:apply: npm run k8s:namespace && npm run k8s:deployment && npm run k8s:service && npm run k8s:apirule
scripts.k8s:status: kubectl get pods -n cap-service && kubectl get apirule -n cap-service
scripts.deploy: npm run docker:build-push && npm run k8s:apply && npm run k8s:status
